Fama/French variables

Source: R/data.r
variables.Rd

Helper dataset. Provides details on Fama/French variables, including construction methods. The 48 rows cover every variable, factor and field used across the package's datasets, so any name appearing in the other datasets can be looked up here.

variables

Format

A tibble with variables:

  • name: variable name.

  • symbol: symbol used to refer to a given variable in the various datasets contained in the package. Derived fields (the "value weight average of ..." and "equal weight average of ..." rows) have no symbol (NA).

  • description: variable descriptive elements including construction methods. See https://mba.tuck.dartmouth.edu/pages/faculty/ken.french/Data_Library/variable_definitions.html for more details.

Source

https://mba.tuck.dartmouth.edu/pages/faculty/ken.french/data_library.html.
